dct_title_s: Palo Alto County, Iowa, 1939, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BZY. Form of individual image numbering: BZY-1-[number], BZY-2-[number], or BZY-3-[number]. Flown by Aero Service Corp. Philidelphia, Pa. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within the mosaic. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
